title: Jazz books and Brown's plan to correct them
summary: He reviews books by Delaunay, Shapiro, Rosenthal and others, and plans his own book correcting them.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press
